defective_pattern: Using hyperbolic, dramatic, or emotional prose to artificially inflate word counts or narrative volume.
why_defective: Emotional and exaggerated rhetoric severely damages the credibility, objectivity, and sober tone required in rigorous academic writing.
observed_symptoms: Overuse of intense adjectives or dramatic adverbs.
Sentences padded with emotional descriptors instead of empirical facts.
Loss of neutral, objective tone during text expansion tasks.
corrective_remedy: Strip out all dramatic, emotional, or hyperbolic wording. Rewrite sentences using strictly sober, neutral, and fact-based academic terminology, even if it results in a lower word count.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Presence of dramatic adjectives/adverbs or emotional phrasing in academic text.
